keyFindings: Canonical current official section is Ostkustleden Etapp 1, Lilla Hycklinge - Nynäs, from Lilla Hycklinge parking/trailhead to Nynäs/Nynässtugan in Humlenäs naturreservat near Hummeln.
Best current official distance is 16.0 km from Naturkartan and its Etapp 1 map PDF; Döderhult uses circa 17 km.
No official section-specific walking time or difficulty found for Etapp 1; do not infer difficulty.

Nynäs cabin is for Ostkustleden hikers, has about 15 sleeping places, no electricity, simple kitchen/wood stove, dry toilet, and unreliable water; current Naturkartan wording says the well has dried and lake water from Hummeln should always be boiled.
Current Swedish/Naturkartan cabin fee is 100 SEK/person in cabin and 50 SEK/person for tenting by the cabin; older English page says 70 SEK and should not override Swedish current pages.
Humlenäs rules from Länsstyrelsen include dogs on leash, fire only in own grill/friluftskök/designated places, and no camping more than one day in the same place.
Official direction is Lilla Hycklinge to Nynäs, but the official GPX is stored as two tracks where track 2 runs backwards from the Nynäs/Etapp 2 start area to the same inland join reached by track 1.
Normalize official GPX as track 1 plus reversed track 2; computed normalized length 15.985960 km. Raw concatenation is 20.354076 km because it jumps 4.368117 km.
Official start coordinate: 57.276033434166, 16.3824610921365 from Naturkartan GPX/API/directions target.
Official GPX/Etapp 2 snap endpoint: 57.3578725758454, 16.2658329902812. This matches Etapp 2 GPX start but is about 565.9 m from Nynäs cabin marker.
Nynäs hut marker: 57.35895696767602, 16.25661409275492 from Naturkartan cabin page/API site 55394.
OSM relation 3095117 is continuous and hut-inclusive at about 16.706784 km; useful secondary cross-check but not canonical unless endpoint policy chooses the hut.

Facilities import candidates include Lilla Hycklinge trailhead, Hycklinge Naturcenter parking, Lilla Hycklinge bus stop/access, Lilla Hycklinge cabin, Nynäs cabin, Nynäs well, Nynäs dry toilet, Nynässtugan picnic table, Humlenäs farm dry toilet, Humlenäs picnic/info, Humlenäs nature reserve, Eckern, Sandvik, Högatorp/Högetorp, Sjoketorp, Skarpesten, Lämmedal, and Hummeln.
Nynäs cabin is about 0.55-0.60 km off the official downloaded Etapp 1 GPX, but remains importable as official stage cabin because Naturkartan and Döderhult identify it as the Etapp 1 overnight cabin.
Nynäs outdoor fireplace should be suppressed because Naturkartan explicitly says no outdoor fires and no fire in upstairs fireplace.
Humlenäs small bathing access is pending because Länsstyrelsen confirms it but no accurate separate coordinate was found.
Råsviks badplats, Gertruds i Hycklinge, Fika i Naturcenter, and waste-bin records should be suppressed for Etapp 1 or kept as optional nearby/currentness-dependent only.
Start access: Lilla Hycklinge bus/Närtrafik stop is served by KLT Närtrafik and must be pre-booked; Naturkartan coordinates 57.276143, 16.379913, about 150 m from trailhead.
Busmaps/GTFS places a Lilla Hycklinge stop much closer to the GPX start at 57.275975, 16.382425, about 10 m; keep Naturkartan and GTFS coordinate caveat.
Start parking/trailhead: Parkering Hycklinge Naturcenter at 57.276101, 16.382091, free parking between Etapp 1 and Etapp 8, about 20 m from start.
End endpoint for access: Nynässtugan/Övernattningsstuga Nynäs at 57.358957, 16.256614 from Naturkartan cabin page.

Closest practical bus from Nynäs is Grytbäcken, KLT bus, Naturkartan coordinates 57.357347, 16.239338; about 1.05 km straight-line from Nynässtugan and about 2.2 km along Etapp 2, matching official note that bus access is about 2 km into Etapp 2.
Humlenäs named stop appears in Busmaps around 57.342540, 16.252048 but is less practical/lower confidence for trail access.
Humlenäs nature reserve parking/access point at 57.361579, 16.248219, about 580 m straight-line from Nynässtugan.

Best section-specific firsthand field report is Helenas dagar, published 2015-08-04, which reports a wrong turn at Lämmedal that turned Etapp 1 from about 17 km into about 21 km and describes very wet conditions.

AllTrails whole-route reviews from 2025 and 2022 warn that the route can be hard to follow and that third-party GPX may not match current marked route; useful as low-confidence whole-trail currentness context.

Naturkartan Nynäs cabin page now says the well has dried up and water must be fetched from Lake Hummeln and boiled; this is stronger than older maintainer/travel-guide wording that the well can dry in late summer.
Naturkartan Nynäs cabin page notes forestry work nearby during late summer/autumn 2025 and no fire in the upstairs fireplace or outdoors.

Etapp 1 ends at or immediately by Humlenäs naturreservat, so Humlenäs reserve rules are section-relevant: dogs leashed, camping max one day in same place, fire only in own grill/outdoor stove/designated places, no damage/disturbance to flora/fauna.
Nynäs cabin has stricter site fire guidance: no fire in upstairs fireplace and no outdoor fires at the cabin.

Potential import-affecting currentness conflict: Naturkartan Nynäs cabin page may say cabins are winter-closed 1 November-31 March, while broader Ostkustleden sources say stage cabins are open year-round; verify with trail contact before publishing winter cabin access.
Oskarshamn fire-ban page currently says no fire ban in Oskarshamn municipality, but fire status is volatile and Länsstyrelsen showed forest-fire-risk notice; same-day fire-ban check required.
Hummeln is a protected surface-water source and Eckern is listed by Oskarshamn as a reserve water source; avoid contamination/soap/washing and record water-protection caution.
No official current Etapp 1 closure/reroute found, but 2025 forestry notice near Nynäs remains a currentness risk.

geometry.notes: Etapp 1 official GPX can be normalized as track 1 plus reversed track 2, but endpoint policy is unresolved because the official GPX/Etapp 2 snap point is about 0.56 km from Nynäs cabin. Other sections retain Phase 1 precheck status.

commuteAccess.notes: Etapp 1 start has KLT Närtrafik at Lilla Hycklinge and free Hycklinge Naturcenter parking. Etapp 1 end has no bus at the cabin; best trail-connected bus is Grytbäcken about 2.2 km into Etapp 2.

facilities.notes: Etapp 1 has importable endpoint/access/cabin/toilet/water/POI candidates, but Nynäs cluster is off the official GPX by about 0.56 km and needs endpoint-policy handling.

fieldReports.notes: Etapp 1 has one strong older firsthand report (2015-08-04) of a wrong turn at Lämmedal and wet conditions; recent AllTrails reports are whole-route/low section specificity but warn about route-following and stale third-party GPX.
